articles.title: Hugging Face hack exposes the open-weight AI cybersecurity paradox
articles.snippet: Hugging Face relies on open weight Chinese models to defend itself from rogue AI agents. But a lack of safety guardrails makes those models potentially dangerous too.

articles.title: Gemini plans to distribute crypto prediction markets through Apex brokerages
articles.snippet: The proposed deal would make Gemini the exclusive venue for crypto event contracts offered through Apex’s FCM, expanding its prediction-market reach to brokerage clients.

articles.title: Gold Hits Three-Month High as Bitcoin Tests $80,000
articles.snippet: Gold extended its August rally as a weaker dollar and falling yields boosted demand, while Bitcoin briefly climbed above $80,000 for the first time since May.

articles.title: Crypto Fund Founder Convicted of Fraud Over Fake Trading Bot
articles.snippet: Japheth Dillman told investors that Block Bits Capital's "Autotrader" software was finished and running, and took nearly $1 million.

articles.title: Dozens of Fake Firefox Wallet Extensions Linked to Crypto-Stealing Malware
articles.snippet: Forty are confirmed malicious, impersonating OKX, Rabby and TronLink to harvest recovery phrases from anyone who types one in.
